_handoff.scopeNote: Official-source pass for Bengaluru municipal property-tax title/name transfer (khata mutation). Sources are Karnataka legislation/rules, BBMP Revenue guidance, and official BBMP/GBA property-tax interfaces. No login, property lookup, payment, objection, or application submission was performed.
_handoff.currentnessNote: The BBMP site lists later amendments and the Revenue FAQ/checklists are undated or legacy. Claims distinguish binding text from official guidance and do not treat the published material as a complete current end-to-end procedure.

sources.title: Bruhat Bengaluru Mahanagara Palike Act, 2020 (official BBMP copy, as amended by Act 12 of 2023)
sources.notes: Sections 149-150 are the relevant transfer-of-title and review provisions. The BBMP index also lists later amendments, including a 2025 amendment; this copy is not asserted to be a complete current compilation.

sources.title: BBMP Property Tax Assessment, Recovery and Management Rules, 2024
sources.notes: Rule 10 and Forms 18-24 provide the published mutation intake, notice, objection, and order structure.

sources.title: Property tax Rules-2024 (SOP)
sources.notes: Official SOP/specimen-form publication. It repeats Form 22's request to enter names from a registered deed when the Sub-Registrar intimation has not reached BBMP.

sources.title: Revenue Department — Documents Required for Khatha Services
sources.notes: Undated official checklist with sale, inheritance, gift, court-decree, and partition/release branches. It should be reconciled with current e-Aasthi implementation.

sources.title: Revenue Department — Frequently Asked Questions
sources.notes: Undated/legacy FAQ describing prescribed-form filing with the ARO, current-tax proof, timing, and transfer fee. It cites the 1976 Act and is retained with a currentness limitation.

sources.title: Katha Services Fee Details
sources.notes: Official fee page; it states 2% administrative mutation charge on stamp duty and a minimum of Rs.500, plus separate registration improvement charges.

sources.title: BBMP Acts, Rules and Circulars index
sources.notes: Current index observed to list the 2024 property-tax rules, 2024 amendments, and a BBMP Revenue Act amendment dated 10-01-2025.

sources.title: BBMP Property Tax System — help and correction routes
sources.notes: Current public page exposes name-change correction capabilities, ARO search, payment/status support, and Revenue contact details; it also labels the feature list as last updated 27-06-2017.

claims.text: Section 149(1) of the published BBMP Act text states that the transferor and transferee must give notice of transfer of title within three months after execution, registration, or the transfer being effected, as applicable.
claims.notes: Binding-text claim, but the accessed copy is as amended by Act 12 of 2023 and the official index lists later amendments.

claims.text: Section 149(2) of the published BBMP Act text states that a person receiving title as heir or otherwise after the death of the person primarily liable must give notice within one year from the death.
claims.notes: Statutory timing only; it does not establish the current form or accepted successor evidence.

claims.text: Section 149(3) of the published BBMP Act text states that when a transfer comes to the Chief Commissioner's or authorised officer's knowledge through notice or otherwise, the transferee's name is to be entered in the property-tax register.
claims.notes: Describes the statutory register outcome, not a property-specific update.

claims.text: Rule 10 of the 2024 BBMP property-tax rules provides mutation information from a Sub-Registrar Form 18 intimation slip, an authorised-officer or court order, or information supplied by an interested person, with the information recorded in the prescribed mutation registers.
claims.notes: Published rule routes; it does not establish which route a specific property will expose.

claims.text: Rule 10 prescribes Form 21 for an inheritor, survivor, or successor after death, and Form 22 for a registered deed where the Sub-Registrar intimation slip has not reached BBMP; Form 22 calls for a certified copy of the registered deed.
claims.notes: Prescribed legal forms; no current blank submission screen was inspected.

claims.text: Rule 10 and Form 23 provide for publication and individual notice concerning a mutation entry, with at least fifteen days to submit an objection in writing or online.
claims.notes: Published objection opportunity; no particular notice or objection was observed.

claims.text: Rule 10 and Form 24 state that when no objection is received within the notice period, the authorised officer may certify the mutation and issue an e-Khata order recording the transferred name in property-tax records.
claims.notes: Conditional legal sequence, not an approval promise or service-level time.

claims.text: The BBMP Revenue checklist lists a sale deed, current-year property-tax receipt, and Form 15 encumbrance certificate from the sale-deed date to the current date for khatha transfer through sale deed.
claims.notes: Undated published checklist; current e-Aasthi validation and whether every listed item is mandatory are not established.

claims.text: The BBMP Revenue checklist publishes separate inheritance-with-will and inheritance-without-will branches, including prior title/possession evidence, current tax receipt, death evidence, family-tree/NOC material in stated cases, and an encumbrance certificate.
claims.notes: The checklist is scenario-specific and undated; do not generalise it to all succession cases.

claims.text: The BBMP Revenue FAQ says a title holder may apply in the prescribed form to the concerned Assistant Revenue Officer, should include proof of up-to-date property-tax payment for change of khatha, and describes a 2% transfer fee on the sale deed's stamp-duty value.
claims.notes: The filing/fee statements are direct official guidance but undated/legacy and not reconciled on-page with the 2024 rules or current e-Aasthi route.

claims.text: The public BBMP Property Tax System page lists name/address change among property corrections and directs users with name or receipt discrepancies to Find Your ARO, while publishing Revenue contact details.
claims.notes: The page also identifies its feature list as last updated 27-06-2017; current eligibility and response are not established.
